moral: A brave voice can be small and still say something true.
summary: Parvati feels her voice hide, then uses a blue ribbon to point out the North Star and tell her family that it stays so people can find their way.

title: The Turn Ribbon Across the Rug
youtube_title: The Turn Ribbon Across the Rug | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A fair turn is a promise that keeps sharing cozy.
summary: Luca lays a turn ribbon so he and Papa trade the telescope after one cricket song, then splits the biscuits and the last milk the same fair way.

title: The Marble That Held a Tiny Moon
youtube_title: The Marble That Held a Tiny Moon | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Careful looking lets a question grow without breaking what you love.
summary: Bibi discovers a lamp and a moon inside a glass marble, then looks at drops and leaves with Mama without startling the cricket.

title: The Crown That Did Not Fall from the Moon
youtube_title: The Crown That Did Not Fall from the Moon | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A true story about what you made is stronger than a shiny pretend one.
summary: Soren almost claims his paper crown fell from the moon, then tells Grandpa he cut and glued it himself and keeps the true story.

title: The Slow-Crab Walk with the Wide Tray
youtube_title: The Slow-Crab Walk with the Wide Tray | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A big job feels lighter when two people each take a side.
summary: Asha cannot hold the wide tray alone, so she and Uncle walk it like a slow crab, share the quilt corners, and trade telescope jobs without losing the moon.

title: Quentin's Lampmoon in the Window
youtube_title: Quentin's Lampmoon in the Window | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A homemade light can glow beside the real sky without needing to be the only one.
summary: Quentin paints a round Lampmoon, tapes it beside the real moon, and hides a smaller one inside the cardboard tube as a surprise for Grandma.

title: The White Flowers That Kept Their Night Shift
youtube_title: The White Flowers That Kept Their Night Shift | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Caring can mean leaving a flower where it can keep blooming.
summary: Mabel almost picks a perfect white balcony flower, then sniffs, draws, and waters just enough so the plant keeps its night choir.

title: Two Tubes and a Striped Sock
youtube_title: Two Tubes and a Striped Sock | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friendship is looking at the same moment side by side.
summary: Idris ties two cardboard tubes together with a striped sock so he and Grandma can look at the moon together and share the same small oh.

title: Ada and the Second Hello
youtube_title: Ada and the Second Hello | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A smudge is not the end of a kind idea, and trying again can fill an empty mailbox with warmth.
summary: Ada wants to leave kind notes, but paint on her thumb smears the first one. Mei helps her wash up and write sunny notes for friends, including a spare hello so no mailbox feels left out.

title: Kwame and the Slow Bean
youtube_title: Kwame and the Slow Bean | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Waiting can be a kind of care, and quiet growing still counts.
summary: Kwame's bean is slower than Ruth's. He wants to hurry it, then chooses to keep the towel damp and wait. A pale root appears when he gives the seed time.

title: Polly and the Whisper Puppet
youtube_title: Polly and the Whisper Puppet | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be a clear small voice that stays to the end of the line.
summary: Polly wants to welcome friends with a mouse puppet, but her voice hides. She and Jalen practice a gentle duet on the rug, and Polly speaks her line clearly for a small audience.

title: Victor Shares the Sunny Yellow
youtube_title: Victor Shares the Sunny Yellow | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing a color can make two pictures brighter than keeping it all.
summary: Victor has the last full cup of yellow paint, and Salma needs a little for her poster sun. They share the cup and mix a honey-gold for the edges so both fair posters glow.

title: Mei Follows the Paper Leaf
youtube_title: Mei Follows the Paper Leaf | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Curiosity is careful looking that leaves a new question for the next friend.
summary: Mei finds a hand-drawn library map in a picture book. She and Omar follow it to nature books and a seed jar, then add kind new questions for the next readers.

title: Omar and the Blue Button
youtube_title: Omar and the Blue Button | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Saying what you want, and still returning what is not yours, keeps trust strong.
summary: Omar finds a blue button that would suit a puppet coat. He tells Cora he wanted it, then returns it to her cardigan and makes an honest paper button instead.

title: Ruth and the Long Banner
youtube_title: Ruth and the Long Banner | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Teamwork is each person holding a different part of the same welcome.
summary: The fair banner is too long for one child to hold and paint. Ruth, Pietro, and Faye trade jobs, add cloth when the word needs room, and hang a straight, friendly welcome.

title: Stefan and the Leaning Sprout
youtube_title: Stefan and the Leaning Sprout | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Nature is a neighbor to notice, not a thing to grab.
summary: Stefan and Nola watch seed jars in a patch of library sun, compare them with a fallen leaf, and learn that stems lean toward light. They leave the living plants unpicked.

title: Ines and the Chalk Cloud
youtube_title: Ines and the Chalk Cloud | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A smudge can become a new idea when friends create together.
summary: Kenji accidentally smudges Ines's chalk bird. They turn the smear into a smiling cloud and draw a path of birds and flowers that leads to the library steps.

title: Jalen and the Shared Page
youtube_title: Jalen and the Shared Page | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friendship grows when a saved seat becomes a shared story.
summary: Jalen finds Polly reading the boat book he hoped to open. He sits beside her, and they notice different details together, then leave a kind note for the next readers.

title: Cora Mends the Torn Corner
youtube_title: Cora Mends the Torn Corner | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness includes caring for a book so the next reader finds it whole.
summary: Cora notices a small tear in a rabbit picture book. She and Ada hinge it with a soft paper strip, read the page gently, and leave the mended book ready for friends.

title: Dimitri and the Slow Shaker
youtube_title: Dimitri and the Slow Shaker | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience gives a song its shape by leaving room between the sounds.
summary: Dimitri's fast shaking covers Hugh's hummed song. Hugh shows a shake-and-rest pattern, and Dimitri learns to pause so their shakers sound like gentle rain.

title: Abena and the Fair Hello
youtube_title: Abena and the Fair Hello | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be a steady sentence spoken in the sunshine with a friend nearby.
summary: Abena is meant to welcome friends at the fair, and her voice feels tucked away. Tariq helps her practice from one person to the banner to the courtyard, and she speaks clearly.

title: Hugh and the Wide Blue Sky
youtube_title: Hugh and the Wide Blue Sky | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A shared sky has room for every hand that helps to paint it.
summary: Hugh begins a backdrop sky alone, then invites Victor and Mei to paint bands of blue with him. Their birds, cloud, and hill make one wide sky for the puppet show.

title: Salma and the Two Jars
youtube_title: Salma and the Two Jars | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Curiosity looks closely, tells the truth, and lets living things answer in their own time.
summary: Salma wonders why one seed jar is taller. She and Kwame see that books had shaded the shorter jar. They move the shade, leave a seed coat alone, and write an honest log.

title: Pietro and the Honest Dot
youtube_title: Pietro and the Honest Dot | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Telling the truth right away keeps a small accident small and lets a fix begin.
summary: Pietro's elbow sends a blue drop onto Ines's chalk-path copy. He tells her at once. Together they lift a little color and turn the dot into a beetle with pencil legs.

title: Nola and the Puppet Garden
youtube_title: Nola and the Puppet Garden | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Teamwork lets each person do one job well so the whole story can shine.
summary: Nola cannot wave the mouse and hold the vine at once. Stefan handles the paper garden, Abena keeps the shaker cues, and Nola speaks for the mouse, so the little show works.

title: Kenji and the Fallen Leaf
youtube_title: Kenji and the Fallen Leaf | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Caring for nature means noticing closely and leaving living things whole.
summary: Kenji and Faye make chalk rubbings of bark and a fallen leaf, return the leaf to the soil, and compare its veins with the sprouts in the library window jars.

title: Faye and the Color Song
youtube_title: Faye and the Color Song | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Creativity can mix colors and sounds until a picture and a song share one shape.
summary: Faye paints while Dimitri and Polly play color patterns on shakers. Rests become white space, taps become dots, and a listening spiral ties the fair painting together.

title: Tariq and the Mixed-Up Notes
youtube_title: Tariq and the Mixed-Up Notes | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friends help a kind idea find the right person, even after a mix-up.
summary: Tariq swaps notes meant for Omar and Ruth. He says so at once, they trade the notes back, and they add small pictures so the next delivery is easier to get right.

title: Lila and the Blue Creek Cup
youtube_title: Lila and the Blue Creek Cup | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness means returning what you find, even when you wish you could keep it for a little while.
summary: Lila finds a painted cup by the creek and wants to use it as a harbor for her leaf boat, then walks it back to the neighbor boy who lost it and shares the slow pool instead.

title: Sami and the Honey Bun That Wasn't Ready
youtube_title: Sami and the Honey Bun That Wasn't Ready | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience lets good things finish becoming what they are meant to be.
summary: Sami wants a honey bun that is still baking at the night market, learns to wait instead of taking a rushed cold one, and helps at the stall until the bun is ready to share.

title: Nora and the Stiff Treehouse Latch
youtube_title: Nora and the Stiff Treehouse Latch | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be a small voice that asks for help at the right moment.
summary: Nora wants to join the afternoon story in the oak treehouse, but the latch is stiff and she feels shy about asking, so she climbs the last steps and asks for help, and together they open the door.

title: Hugo and the Ferry Cracker Tin
youtube_title: Hugo and the Ferry Cracker Tin | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing a small snack can make a long ride feel friendly for everyone.
summary: On an evening ferry ride Hugo's neighbor child spills their crackers into a napkin mess, and Hugo shares his own tin so both of them have a snack while they watch the harbor lights.

title: Imani and the Orchard That Was Not Finished
youtube_title: Imani and the Orchard That Was Not Finished | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Wonder grows when you look again at a place you thought had nothing left to show you.
summary: Imani thinks the orchard is used up after the baskets are full, then slows down and notices dew, moths, low fruit, and evening lights in the grass, filling her empty sketch with wonder.

title: Theo and the Stamp That Slipped
youtube_title: Theo and the Stamp That Slipped | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness is returning a small treasure so someone else's message can go on its way.
summary: At the post office Theo finds a bright stamp that fell off a neighbor's letter, wants to keep its picture, and instead returns it so the letter can be mailed.

title: Willa and the Tangled Kite String
youtube_title: Willa and the Tangled Kite String | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience untangles what hurrying only tightens.
summary: Willa's kite string tangles on the hill and she wants to yank it free, but she sits and loosens each loop until the kite can rise.

title: Kenji Tells the Pot the Truth
youtube_title: Kenji Tells the Pot the Truth | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage is speaking up early so a small worry can be fixed with care.
summary: Kenji is stirring soup when the pot starts bubbling faster than he was told it should, and instead of staying quiet he tells Grandma so they can lower the heat together.

title: Bea and the Creek Pebble Crown
youtube_title: Bea and the Creek Pebble Crown | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing the best pieces can make two smaller joys instead of one lonely pile.
summary: Bea collects the shiniest pebbles for a crown and then shares them with a visiting child who has an empty tin, so they can each make a pattern on the bank.

title: Omar Follows the Blue Scarf Smell
youtube_title: Omar Follows the Blue Scarf Smell | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Wonder helps you notice the clues that lead you back to what matters.
summary: Omar is supposed to remember which night-market stall has the blue scarf Papa wants to pick up, loses the place in the crowd of colors, and finds it again by noticing smells, sounds, and a painted kettle.

title: Hana and the Damp Cushion
youtube_title: Hana and the Damp Cushion | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness tells the truth about a mess and stays to help tidy it.
summary: Hana spills a cup of water on the treehouse story cushion and chooses to tell her cousin and help dry it so everyone can keep reading.

title: Felix Waits for the Ferry Bell
youtube_title: Felix Waits for the Ferry Bell | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience keeps a busy moment gentle for you and for everyone nearby.
summary: Felix wants to run to the front of the ferry before it is ready, waits for the deck bell instead, and enjoys a calm walk to the best view.

title: Rosa and the Second Orchard Step
youtube_title: Rosa and the Second Orchard Step | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be one small step, and then one more, with a steady helper nearby.
summary: Rosa wants to pick a ripe pear for Grandma's basket but hesitates at the short ladder, then climbs one step and the next while Grandma holds it steady.

title: Samir's Ribbon at the Parcel Table
youtube_title: Samir's Ribbon at the Parcel Table | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing what you have enough of can help two good things go out into the world.
summary: Samir brings a long ribbon to tie a parcel at the post office, meets a child whose string has frayed, and shares the ribbon so both parcels can be mailed.

title: Leila and the Hill of Soft Clouds
youtube_title: Leila and the Hill of Soft Clouds | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Wonder can turn a changed plan into a sky full of new things to see.
summary: Leila hopes to point out the far town from the hill, but a soft mist hides it, so she watches cloud shapes and listens for the town bell instead.

title: Micah and the Warm Extra Muffin
youtube_title: Micah and the Warm Extra Muffin | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness can mean giving the warm piece you hoped to keep.
summary: Micah bakes a small tray of muffins and, when a neighbor child returns a bowl at the door, shares the warm one he wanted so they can eat together.

title: Nell Waits for the Clear Creek
youtube_title: Nell Waits for the Clear Creek | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience lets muddy water settle until what you hope to see can appear.
summary: After rain the creek is cloudy and Nell cannot see the stones she painted yesterday, so she waits on the bank until the water clears.

title: Arun's Three Quiet Drumbeats
youtube_title: Arun's Three Quiet Drumbeats | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can sound as soft as three gentle beats when you decide to begin.
summary: At the night market a drum keeper invites children to tap a quiet pattern, and shy Arun steps forward to play three gentle beats.

title: Cleo Shares the Only Picture Book
youtube_title: Cleo Shares the Only Picture Book | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing a story by reading it aloud lets everyone have the same bright pages.
summary: Cleo has the only picture book in the treehouse when two visitors want different pages, so she reads aloud and turns the pages slowly so everyone can see.

title: Yusuf and the Ferry's Long Lights
youtube_title: Yusuf and the Ferry's Long Lights | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Wonder fills a quiet ride when you let your eyes gather what is already there.
summary: Yusuf thinks the evening ferry ride is too long and empty, then notices reflections, rope smells, and stretched lights, and fills his postcard sketch with them.

title: The Blue Bird Letter in Kind Hands
youtube_title: The Blue Bird Letter in Kind Hands | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness should be careful as well as willing.
summary: Camila buys a bird stamp for Grandma, then walks Mrs. Adeyemi's waiting letter home by hand so a high step does not keep the news away.
